## Review checklist

- [ ] One FR per branch and pull request, or branch uses `ci/...` / `docs/...`.
- [ ] The branch starts from current `main`; no direct `main` push or review bypass.
- [ ] The user owns pull request creation and merge; CodeRabbit is triggered only on explicit user request.
- [ ] Checks reflect commands that exist in the repository; no runtime check is claimed without evidence.
- [ ] Market information includes source, units/currency, timezone, as-of time, and freshness where applicable.
- [ ] Review conversations are resolved and CI has been rerun after changes.
